description: Record the opening and last reply sequence this task actually received in a thread. A space_read_thread call with regex or an author filter skips replies, so never record from one. This records a receipt without subscribing. requested_observed_reply_count echoes your input rather than a verified receipt, and shared seen state may be ahead of this task, so retain its actual read cursor. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.
